title: Rigidity of Strain Tensors for Surfaces With Mixed Type and Applications To Shell Theory
summary: This paper investigates the rigidity of strain tensors on surfaces with sign-changing Gaussian curvature (mixed-type surfaces) and applies the results to determine the optimal thickness exponent in the first Korn inequality for thin shells. Using tools from Riemannian geometry and generalized tensor analysis, we derive an infinitesimal rigidity lemma for strain tensors, which establishes \(L^2\) regularity estimates for displacements decomposed into tangential and normal components.
